 The Pittsburgh Penguins (6-10-2) have fallen to last in the Eastern Conference as they await execution. They face a young team that is unexpectedly also struggling Wednesday when they face the San Jose Sharks at the SAP Center.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The puck drops just after 10 p.m. EST.
 For the first time this season, the Penguins are a road favorite, and the FanDuel odds have them as a big favorite, -140, and in all of the extra bets, too .
